Record completion of runs whose launching session ended

Source: R/finalize_runs.R
finalize_runs.Rd

Records completion, marked as recorded late, for runs that were launched but never recorded, for example because the R session that launched them died. A run with a job ID is recorded once its job has left the queue (sq). A run launched with the local runners monolix.sh, pkanalix.sh or simulx.sh had finished before its launch was recorded, so it is recorded straight away. Any other run without a job ID is recorded once its output folder holds one of its project type's result files (summary.txt for Monolix). If sq is missing or fails the function stops, because a running job would otherwise be recorded as finished.

Usage

finalize_runs(store = default_store(), run_id = NULL, retry_crashed = FALSE)

Arguments

store

Character scalar. The run store directory (see default_store()). Defaults to default_store().

run_id

Character vector. Limit finalization to these run IDs. NULL (default) considers every run in the store.

retry_crashed

Logical. Record runs whose earlier completion attempt crashed into a fresh attempt folder. Otherwise they are only reported.

Value

A data frame with columns run_id and action, one row per run that was considered. action is "recorded_late", "still_queued", "no_summary_yet", "claimed_elsewhere", "completion_crashed", "other_user" or "skipped_submit_failed" (only for runs named in run_id). Recorded runs are not listed.

Details

Only runs whose run.json user is the current user are recorded, because sq may list only the current user's jobs and another user's running job would then look finished. Other users' runs are reported as "other_user" and must be finalized by their owner.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
finalize_runs()
finalize_runs(retry_crashed = TRUE)
} # }
